**RED FEATHERED DRAGON**
*Gargantuan dragon (chromatic), chaotic evil*
**AC** 22 (natural armor)
**HP** 574 (28d20 + 280)
**Speed** 60 ft., climb 60 ft., fly 120 ft.
**STR** 30 (+10) | **DEX** 14 (+2) | **CON** 30 (+10) | **INT** 22 (+6) | **WIS** 15 (+2) | **CHA** 26 (+8)
**Saving Throws** Dex +10, Con +18, Wis +10, Cha +16
**Skills** Perception +21, Stealth +10
**Immunities** fire
**Condition Immunities** charmed, frightened, exhaustion
**Senses** truesight 120 ft., passive Perception 31
**Languages** Common, Draconic
**CR** 26 (90,000 XP) **Proficiency Bonus** +8

**TRAITS**
*Eidolic*

**LEGENDARY REACTIONS** (4 uses)
TBA

***Uncanny Flames.*** Fire damage from the dragon ignores resistances, and immunity to fire damage only reduces the damage to half instead. This does not apply to damage the dragon might deal to itself.

**ACTIONS**
***Multiattack.*** The dragon makes one Bite and two Claw attacks.

***Bite.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +18 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 20 (2d10 + 10) piercing damage plus 18 (3d12) fire damage.

***Claw.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +18 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 18 (2d8 + 10) slashing damage. If the target is Huge or smaller, it is restrained and grappled (escape DC 20). While grappling a creature it cannot make Claw attacks except one each turn against the grappled creature.

***Tail.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +18 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. *Hit:* 22 (2d12 + 10) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed a DC 26 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

***Breath Weapon (Recharge 5-6).*** The dragon uses one of its breath weapon options (Hellfire Breath or Meteorfall).
• ***Hellfire Breath.*** The dragon exhales a burst of fire targeting a point it can see within 300 feet, which explodes in a 60-foot-radius sphere of hellish fire. All creatures within range must make a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw, taking 88 (16d10) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
• ***Meteorfall.*** The dragon blasts six meteor-like balls of fire and brimstone, each at a point within 180 feet of itself that it can see. Each explodes in a 15-foot-radius sphere. None of the spheres can overlap, and creatures caught in multiple spheres are only targeted once. Each creature caught in these spheres must make a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure they take 35 (10d6) fire damage and are knocked prone and stunned until the end of their next turn, and take half as much damage and aren’t stunned or knocked prone on a success. Creatures that fail are also set on fire, taking 2d8 fire damage at the start of each of their turns, until they use an action to douse themselves.

**BONUS ACTIONS**
***Change Shape.*** The dragon transforms into any creature that is Medium, Small or Tiny, while retaining its game statistics (other than its size), though if it is Tiny it cannot use its Multiattack. This transformation ends if the dragon is reduced to 0 hit points or uses a bonus action to end it.

**REACTIONS**
***Beyond the Web (Recharge 5-6).*** When one or more creatures within 120 feet of the feathered dragon is targeted by the same magical effect or spell (except itself), the feathered dragon may grant them a +5 bonus on the first save they make against it.

***Burning Shroud.*** In response to an attack targeting it, the dragon wreaths itself in hellish fire until the end of the turn. While wreathed in these flames it gains half cover against all attacks made against it, and any attack made against it from within 10 feet causes the attacker to take 2d6 fire damage.

**LEGENDARY ACTIONS (3 ACTIONS)**
***Attack.*** The dragon makes one Claw or Tail attack.
***Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions).*** The dragon beats its wings, spreading flames from its body. Each creature within 20 feet of it must succeed on a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw or take 16 (1d12 + 10) bludgeoning damage plus 6 (1d12) fire damage and be knocked prone. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.
***Storm of Ashes (Costs 3 Actions).*** A burning wind carrying black ash and embers surrounds the dragon until the start of its next turn, granting ranged attacks against them disadvantage during that time. Any creature who starts their turn within 10 feet of the dragon or enters that space for the first time on their turn takes 10 (2d10) fire damage.
